newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 tiptoes higher in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 tiptoes higher in cautious trade.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index crept modestly higher on Tuesday following a bout of profit-taking at the start of the week prompted by nervousness ahead of next month's UK Budget.
The leading index was up 7.3 points at 4,752.4 by 0740 GMT. Gainers outnumbed losers two-to-one. But second-line stocks opened weaker and the Mid-250 was down 4.8 points at 4,552.3.

"We're only three weeks away from the budget now and I think the market will continue to be nervous," said one trader. "We still look vulnerable to more profit-taking because there's a lot of profits to be taken."
